_readme: Settings for the research-lab topic-selection run. See RESEARCH_PROMPT.md — this file holds everything that section says must live outside the code, so it can be changed without touching a .js file. Read it through lib/research-config.js, which validates it and applies env overrides. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_kk_roles: Injected into the model so it can judge conflicts it was not explicitly told about. UPDATE THE MOMENT A ROLE CHANGES — this is the first line of defence, not a bio.
_conflict_filter: Topics that never become candidates. `id` is stable so logs stay readable when the wording changes; `role` records which hat makes it a conflict, so a resigned role points straight at the entries to delete.

conflict_filter.rule: 한국 상장사 비트코인/디지털자산 트레저리(DAT) 전략 — 특히 KOSDAQ 상장 DAT 기업 사례 분석·비교
국내 저축은행·지방금융지주·금융위/금감원 리스크관리·내부통제 이슈를 직접 다루는 주제
국내 크라우드펀딩·P2P 금융·조각투자 규제·시장 동향을 정면으로 다루는 주제
국내 가상자산거래소의 상장·상장폐지 정책, 거래소 간 경쟁·점유율을 정면으로 다루는 주제
특정 국내 디지털자산 기업의 사업전략·자금조달·기업가치를 개별 종목 수준에서 분석하는 주제

_retired_roles: Kept so a future reader knows an entry was removed on purpose, not lost. Nothing here is enforced.
_models: Tried in order; a model that 404s or is not enabled on the account falls through to the next. Env RESEARCH_MODEL / RESEARCH_SCAN_MODEL override these as comma-separated lists. If every entry fails the run is held — never guess a model id.
_whitelist: Appendix A of RESEARCH_PROMPT.md. Load-bearing: a candidate supported only by sources outside this list is capped at 5 on evidence availability. Review quarterly.

whitelist.scope: on-chain 시장 지표, 보유자 분포, MVRV 등
whitelist.note: 지표 정의는 Glassnode 용어집 기준 명시 필수
체인별 커버리지 다름 — 반드시 체인 명시
유료/무료 티어에 따라 데이터 지연 가능 — 인용 시 확인
개인 제작 대시보드는 검증 후 사용, 방법론 불명확 시 제외

_weights: Must sum to 1. The orchestrator computes the weighted sum in code, not in the model — same scores in, same ranking out, every time.
_tiebreak: Applied in order when weighted sums are level or near-level. Differentiation leads because a non-consensus angle is the whole point of the publication.
_evidence_hard_rules: Caps applied on top of the model's own score. The model must state in its one-line rationale when a cap fired.
_recency_scale: Days since the triggering story → score. Set for a twice-weekly cadence; retune together with `schedule` if the cadence changes. Use the most recent trigger when there are several.
_schedule: Cron is UTC. KST is UTC+9, so an 08:00 KST run fires the PREVIOUS day in UTC — Mon/Thu 23:00 UTC is Tue/Fri 08:00 KST. Getting the weekday shift wrong is the one mistake this comment exists to prevent.
_approval: The run stops before sending and waits for KK. One reminder, then it goes quiet — it never publishes on silence. The report is archived either way, so a missed notification costs a send, not the day's work.
_telegram: summary_max_chars is the target for the <<<TELEGRAM_START>>> block. Telegram's real per-message ceiling is 4096; the gap is headroom, and anything over it is split at paragraph boundaries.
